summary: preinstall script exfiltrates installer host identifiers via DNS out-of-band channel and HTTP POST
details: The package's preinstall.js runs unconditionally on `npm install` and collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username (with USER/USERNAME env fallback), current working directory, install path, platform, node version, and npm user-agent, along with a hardcoded token 'swisscom-oce-3b9f1c7a2e'. The collected identifiers are transmitted through three channels: (1) hex-encoded DNS labels via dns.lookup() to the Interactsh subdomain dae7n4pijsh1ahi9684gu8get3kaiefc9.oast.online, providing a covert out-of-band exfiltration channel that bypasses HTTP egress filters; (2) an HTTPS POST to the same host at /beacon/<token>; and (3) a plain-HTTP POST to the bare IPv4 address 5.189.159.252. In-source comments framing this as authorized bug-bounty research are author-controlled and do not match the destinations, which are not first-party to any legitimate service.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
